sloka: स दृष्ट्वा सूर्यसङ्काशं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।उपविष्टं वसिष्ठस्य सव्यपार्श्वे महामुनिम् ।। ७.५१.४ ॥
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā sūryasaṅkāśaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā ।upaviṣṭaṁ vasiṣṭhasya savyapārśve mahāmunim ।। 7.51.4 ॥

translations.english: He (Rama) saw the great sage, who resembled the sun and blazed with splendor, seated on the left side of Vasistha.
